text.p: Duramed Pharmaceuticals Inc said Thursday that it reached agreement and closed on the issuance of $10 million of Series E convertible preferred stock.
The completion of the offering allows Duramed to continue a product development program and business plan that it expects will, over time, return the company to profitability, it said.
The rate of investment in growth projects will depend upon overall corporate performance, the company said.

The Series E preferred shares will be convertible at the option of the holder at a discount to the closing bid price of the common shares of the company subject to a minimum and maximum, with provisions for cash redemption in certain circumstances, Duramed said.
The financing was managed by Shoreline Pacific, Institutional Finance Division of Financial West Group.
